summary: Adversarial code review completed for mentor workspace backfill: 4 patch findings (1 high, 3 medium), verdict not_clean_for_merge; targeted validations passed (11 tests), but blocking data-integrity and coverage gaps remain.
decisions: Keep review scope constrained to backfill implementation files and associated mentor endpoint tests.
Classify alias-conflict overwrite as a blocking patch finding.
Require follow-up implementation hardening before considering this story review-clean.

risks.risk: Conflicting rows with both `provider_id` and `mentor_id` set to different values are silently rewritten to `provider_id`, potentially altering mentor scoping behavior.
Backfill runs during read flows (`/mentor/*`) and can add unnecessary scan/write overhead under load.
Current tests do not prove idempotency on second pass (`updated == 0`) nor protect inactive/conflict negative paths.
